advice.sentence: Establishing one fact would have made faxes to 1 recipient cheaper or priced over the last 90 days.

recipients.name: Synthetic Lab
recipients.sentence: 2 faxes to Synthetic Lab cost $0.02 by the best route you may use (estimate).

facts.title: No recorded approval for their toll-free number
facts.confirm: Someone at Synthetic Lab must agree that you fax +1 800-555-0199; they pay for those calls.
facts.step: Record who agreed and when under Recipients → Details.
facts.sentence: Would have cost $0.02 less over 2 faxes (estimate). Establishing it takes about 10 minutes of your time. Faxbot will not use it until then.

facts.title: A sending price is missing
facts.confirm: Check the destination price on your sending account.
facts.step: Enter that price in Prices & plans.
facts.sentence: What these faxes would have cost is unknown until you enter a price.

advice.realized: These figures are what your faxes would have cost, not savings. Once a fact is established and used, Costs → Savings counts what it really saved.
advice.note: Faxbot only advises: it never enrolls a partner, records an approval, enters a price or changes a route for you.
assumptions: Each fax of the last 90 days is priced again at today's prices and plan use, by its page count.
